# Beag Labs — Extended Context for AI Agents

Canonical URL: https://beaglabs.com/
Organization: Beag Labs
Product: Papyrus

## Company and product

Beag Labs builds Papyrus, an agentic ERP. Papyrus keeps a data model of the business (customers, vendors, invoices, payments and the record types a team defines) that agents understand and operate. Agents run back-office work; people approve what matters. Teams sign up at https://papyrus.beaglabs.com, Papyrus runs at their own address, and staff sign in with Microsoft.

## Core workflows

### Agentic back office

Agents work accounts payable and receivable, intake, approvals and reconciliation on the shared data model, routing exceptions and consequential actions to a person. See https://beaglabs.com/solutions/agentic-back-office.

### Documents in, ledger out

Invoices, contracts, forms, PDFs and spreadsheets become structured ERP records, reviewed where needed. See https://beaglabs.com/solutions/document-automation.

### Apps on the data model

Create internal apps for requests, approvals and status on the same records. See https://beaglabs.com/solutions/internal-app-factory.

### Existing systems

Connect legacy systems, such as terminal workflows and SOAP/XML services, through OpenAPI-based interfaces that agents can call. See https://beaglabs.com/capability/modernization.

### Governance and deployment

Each Papyrus deployment runs at the customer's own address with Microsoft Entra sign-in and approval of consequential actions. The specific security posture, integrations and supported environments should be verified in the current documentation and agreements.
